$schema_note: Aether CLI flag inventory. Machine-readable companion to the human report.

parser.semantics: Every flag is translated into an AETHER_* environment variable via std::env::set_var before the core runs; a flag BEATS a pre-set variable (set_var overwrites). --tor-bridge/--tor-pt/--tor-pt-dir APPEND (';'-separated). Unknown options are a hard error. No positional args; 'aether help' is the only word-command. Without protocol/scan/ip selection the core asks interactively on stdin (prompt_line, lib.rs L3223).
parser.precedence: CLI flag > pre-set AETHER_* env var > interactive prompt (protocol/scan/ip only) > compiled default. RUST_LOG > AETHER_LOG_LEVEL/--log-level.

runtime_verification.help_vs_source: runtime --help line-for-line identical to the USAGE constant in cli.rs @ d58f9d5 (script-verified)
runtime_verification.caveat: runtime verification covers the Linux x86_64 build only; other platforms use the same source but were not executed here
runtime_verification.bundled: tarball also bundles pt/psiphon-tunnel-core and pt/lyrebird (Go binaries) and LICENSES/

socks5_server_facts.auth: none; handshake always replies method 0x00 regardless of methods offered (socks.rs L475-486)
socks5_server_facts.commands: CONNECT (0x01) and UDP ASSOCIATE (0x03); BIND -> REP 0x07 (socks.rs L452-459)
socks5_server_facts.udp_associate: full RFC 1928 relay (socks.rs L1516-1631): relay bound on the listener IP, first client latches, frag!=0 dropped, V4/V6/DOMAIN targets, domain targets resolved through the tunnel DNS, route rules apply per datagram, association ends when the TCP control connection closes
socks5_server_facts.carrier_only_modes: with --tor-only/--psiphon-only (and tor/psiphon listeners) UDP ASSOCIATE is answered but only DNS (port 53) is carried, over TCP (socks.rs L1084-1093)
socks5_server_facts.readiness: listener bound before the tunnel is up; held connections are accepted by the kernel but the greeting is not answered until the tunnel serves (socks.rs L278-313 answers()/until_answered)
socks5_server_facts.client_limit: AETHER_MAX_CLIENTS semaphore; new clients wait for a free slot
